lines.text: Many learners say: I enjoyed to play tennis.
After enjoy, use playing, not to play.

data.why: After enjoy, use playing, not to play.

native.tip: enjoy のあとに「to＋動詞」は使えません。-ing 形にします。
native.caption: “I enjoyed to play tennis.”と言っていませんか？😅 「楽しむ」の後に to を付けたくなりますが、enjoy のあとは -ing です。“I enjoyed playing tennis.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“running”。同じ形で自分の文を1つ書いてみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.caption: Do you say this? “I enjoyed to play tennis.” 😅 After enjoy, we use -ing, not to. The natural way is “I enjoyed playing tennis.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
